f.t: BD wins repeat order for 20 Bodyguard syringe drivers at North East London NHS FT
f.x: North East London NHS Foundation Trust has placed a repeat order with Becton Dickinson (BD) for 20 Bodyguard syringe drivers, worth £21,340 excluding VAT. The one year contract was signed on 21 September 2026. It confirms BD's syringe driver fleet remains the standard in use at the trust.
